subject: Ganita Prakash (NCERT Grade 8 Mathematics - Part II)

chapters_overview.storyboard_summary: Chapter 1 establishes percentages as fractions disguised with a denominator of 100. It covers inter-conversions between fractions, decimals, ratios, and percentages; mental calculation strategies; estimation techniques; visual bar models; percentages greater than 100%; and practical applications such as profit, loss, and food nutritional label analysis.
key_takeaways: Master core concepts of Fractions in Disguise
Apply analytical formulas to textbook and practical scenarios
Understand visual representations and geometric relationships

chapters_overview.storyboard_summary: Chapter 2 explores the fundamental geometric relationship a^2 + b^2 = c^2 in right-angled triangles, tracing its historical formulation in Baudhāyana's Śulba-Sūtras. It investigates square diagonals, the non-terminating decimal sqrt(2), Baudhāyana triples, geometric dissection proofs, and real-world applications.
key_takeaways: Master core concepts of The Baudhāyana-Pythagoras Theorem
Apply analytical formulas to textbook and practical scenarios
Understand visual representations and geometric relationships

chapters_overview.storyboard_summary: Chapter 3 advances proportional reasoning by examining multi-term ratios (a:b:c:d), map scale representations via Representative Fractions (RF), circular pie charts, and inverse proportional relationships where the product x * y remains constant.
key_takeaways: Master core concepts of Proportional Reasoning-2
Apply analytical formulas to textbook and practical scenarios
Understand visual representations and geometric relationships

image_asset.title: Representative Fraction Map Scale & Pie Chart

chapters_overview.storyboard_summary: Chapter 4 investigates fractals—self-similar geometric figures repeating identical structures across scales—such as the Sierpinski Carpet, Sierpinski Triangle, and Koch Snowflake. It also explores 3D solid visual representations, paper nets, shortest surface paths, and isometric perspective illusions.
key_takeaways: Master core concepts of Exploring Some Geometric Themes
Apply analytical formulas to textbook and practical scenarios
Understand visual representations and geometric relationships

chapters_overview.storyboard_summary: Chapter 5 reimagines the arithmetic mean beyond procedural calculation by introducing a visual dot-plot balance model. It models the mean as a physical fulcrum where total leftward deviation distances equal total rightward deviation distances, and introduces line graphs to track continuous temporal trend data.
key_takeaways: Master core concepts of Tales by Dots and Lines
Apply analytical formulas to textbook and practical scenarios
Understand visual representations and geometric relationships

chapters_overview.storyboard_summary: Chapter 6 demonstrates how symbolic algebraic notation unlocks the mechanics of number tricks, secret-date guessing games, grid cell puzzles, digit-arrangement product optimizations, and divisibility rules.
key_takeaways: Master core concepts of Algebra Play
Apply analytical formulas to textbook and practical scenarios
Understand visual representations and geometric relationships

chapters_overview.storyboard_summary: Chapter 7 explores surface area and perimeter for 2D figures (rectangles, squares, triangles, parallelograms, trapeziums). It uses grid unit-square counting, geometric shear transformations, and dissection methods, addressing common misconceptions regarding area versus perimeter.
key_takeaways: Master core concepts of Area and Perimeter
Apply analytical formulas to textbook and practical scenarios
Understand visual representations and geometric relationships
